previous.question: Delivered orders by payment type in 2018

final.answer: Canceled orders by payment type in 2018

result.sql:
SELECT
  payment__payment_type
  , COUNT(DISTINCT orders_by_payment_type) AS orders_by_payment_type
FROM (
  SELECT
    subq_2.payment__payment_type AS payment__payment_type
    , orders_src_10000.status AS order__status
    , subq_2.__orders_by_payment_type AS orders_by_payment_type
  FROM (
    SELECT
      order_id AS order
      , payment_type AS payment__payment_type
      , order_id AS __orders_by_payment_type
    FROM "olist"."main"."fct_payments" payments_src_10000
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', purchased_at) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31'
  ) subq_2
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "olist"."main"."fct_orders" orders_src_10000
  ON
    subq_2.order = orders_src_10000.order_id
) subq_7
WHERE order__status = 'canceled'
GROUP BY
  payment__payment_type
ORDER BY payment__payment_type

definitions.orders_by_payment_type: Orders that used the payment type, any status; filter order__status for canceled or delivered ones. An order paid two ways (for example a voucher plus a card) counts in both, so payment types add up to more than all orders.
